title: Operators [Arithmetic]
description:
## Arithmetic
QuantumC has standard math operators:
- `+` addition
- `-` subtraction
- `*` multiplication
- `/` division
- `%` modulo
- `**` power (unique to QuantumC!)

```qc
int a = 10;
int b = 3;
println(a + b);  // 13
println(a ** 2); // 100
```
